properties.notes: P/16995/000. Demolition of existing buildings (including the locally listed building at 18-20 Windsor Road). Construction of a part 3 storey, part 4 storey, part 5 storey detached building to accommodate 3 no. retail units at ground floor fronting the Windsor Road; 2no. 1 bed flats to the rear of the ground floor; and 20no. residential flats to the upper floors flats to the upper floors. The building in total would comprise 8no. 2 bed flats; 14no. 1 bed flats; 3no. retail units (total retail 206.1 square metres).
